# sigma_reports (Data Source)

Lists Sigma reports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_reports" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `reports` (Attributes List) Reports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reports))

<a id="nestedatt--reports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reports`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `id` (String) Report ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the report is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest report version.
- `name` (String) Report name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member ID.
- `path` (String) Report path.
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Report URL.
- `url_id` (String) Report URL ID.
